privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for the DMS Distribution Management System mobile and web apps.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how DMS (Distribution Management System) collects, uses, and protects personal information when you use our mobile app and related services at dmscambodia.com.
privacy.whoBody: DMS is operated for distribution ordering, depot operations, and delivery tracking in Cambodia. Contact: admin@dmscambodia.com.
privacy.dataAccount: Account details: name, username, email (if provided), role, and authentication credentials.
privacy.dataOrders: Order and catalog activity: items ordered, quantities, depot/customer links, and delivery status history.
privacy.dataLocation: Precise location: while delivery or tracking features are in use, so dispatch and customers can follow active deliveries.
privacy.dataPayment: Payment-related data needed to process ABA PayWay checkouts (transaction references and payment status). We do not store full card numbers in the DMS app.
privacy.dataDevice: Technical data needed to run the service securely (for example session tokens and basic device/app diagnostics).
privacy.useAuth: To authenticate you and keep your session secure.
privacy.useFulfill: To create, prepare, and fulfill orders between customers, depots, and delivery agents.
privacy.useDispatch: To share live delivery location with authorized dispatch, depot, and customer views while a delivery is active.
privacy.usePay: To start and confirm online payments through our payment provider.
privacy.useSupport: To provide support and improve reliability of the service.
privacy.shareBody: We share data only as needed to operate DMS: with authorized staff roles inside your organization, and with service providers such as ABA PayWay for payments and map providers for map display. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.retainBody: We keep account and order records as long as needed for operations, accounting, and legal obligations. Location updates used for live tracking are retained according to operational needs and then removed or archived.
privacy.deleteBody: You can delete your account from the Profile screen in the DMS mobile app (Delete account). This deactivates your login so you can no longer sign in. You may also email admin@dmscambodia.com to request deletion. Some order and payment records may be retained where required for business or legal reasons.
privacy.securityBody: We use HTTPS and access controls to protect data in transit and limit who can see operational information. No method of transmission is 100% secure; please keep your password confidential.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions or deletion requests, contact

terms.metaDescription: Terms of Service for the DMS Distribution Management System mobile and web apps.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the DMS mobile app and related services. By signing in, you agree to these Terms.
terms.serviceBody: DMS provides ordering, depot batch preparation, payment checkout, and delivery tracking for authorized Customer, Depot, and Delivery accounts.
terms.accountsBody: Accounts are provisioned by your organization. You must keep credentials confidential and use only the account assigned to you. We may deactivate accounts that are misused or inactive.
terms.ordersBody: Orders and payments you submit through DMS are binding according to your commercial arrangement with the operator. Payment processing is handled by ABA PayWay; their terms also apply to payment checkout.
terms.locationBody: Delivery users share location while on duty and tracking screens are active so dispatch and customers can follow deliveries. Do not use tracking features if you do not consent to that sharing.
terms.acceptable1: Do not attempt to access other users’ data or systems without authorization.
terms.acceptable2: Do not interfere with delivery tracking, payments, or order integrity.
terms.acceptable3: Do not use the app for unlawful purposes.
terms.liabilityBody: DMS is provided to support distribution operations. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the app, including delays caused by network or device issues.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we revise them.
